experiment: Feature19 actual independent cold-start semantic grading, one reader/grader pair

graderIdentity.declaration: This agent independently assigned these grades from the actual reader JSON, frozen rubric and cited owners/source; this is grading, not code review.
graderIdentity.identityBasis: DSH_SESSION_ID observed in this agent's environment

gradingPolicy.basis: Frozen rubric correctnessRubric.required, supportingFactsPolicy and unchanged question meaning; cited owner/source material supports answers but does not silently supply materially omitted explanations.
gradingPolicy.timestampPolicy: Reader-qualified collection observations are not retroactively judged against later parent edits. Current owners can confirm stable contracts but cannot reconstruct a frozen collection snapshot.
gradingPolicy.noRetrospectiveAnswerExpansion: The parent suggested expanded routing/maintenance-tradeoff wording. A second direct read of the requested actual JSON confirmed that wording was absent; only this artifact's actual answers were graded.

questionGrades.rationale: Names source and generated project copy, setup/init refresh with prior-byte backup and atomic replacement. Correctly qualifies observed copy mismatch and unverified later refresh; no release claim.

Locates disposable-project copied-CLI behavior checks and focused filter, distinguishes declared full syntax/wiki/doctor/other CI gates and D-15 consolidated timing from actual execution. Commands are adequately anchored by testing and CI citations; no fabricated results.

Separates wiki fact owners, shared AGENTS policy, editable .agents bodies, native aliases/generated Cursor metadata and host-specific settings. Reports rather than hides the observed issue-owner conflict; later documentation repair is not reader error.
questionGrades.qualification: Current ownership now names shared issues.md and local diagnostics; reader explicitly described the older discrepancy.

questionGrades.rationale: Gives init/scaffolding, index/doctor flow, path preflight, authored/partial-map preservation, backed-up generated CLI refresh and remaining human judgement. Standard/full tier qualification matches current source. No unconditional web scaffolding or semantic-verification promise; optional CLI/library detail is not demanded.

Correct orientation, brief/TL;DR/covers routing, explicit budget/default limit, character/4 estimate and dirty/stale/provenance source checks. However, 'mandatory orientation counts against the budget' does not explain required overflow selecting no task pages or skip/fit cap mechanics; completed-feature discount does not state retired exclusion/--history semantics. These required routing facts are materially omitted, not contradicted.
missingRequiredFacts: Mandatory orientation overflow selects no task pages; oversized candidates are skipped while smaller fitting candidates may still be selected.
Retired guidance is excluded by default and explicitly historical under --history.
questionGrades.supportingFactsPolicyApplied: No deduction for omitted low-level lossless Git filename parsing.

questionGrades.rationale: Explains old-or-complete file publication, same-directory fsynced temporary writes, cooperating reentrant advisory serialization and safe ownership recovery, exact archive replay deduplication, lock-free readers and explicit non-cooperating/multi-file/power-loss limits. Makes no unrun crash/race proof claim.

Gives safe name/lexical-real destination and symlink checks, SHIP-only staged tree/manifest, preserved backup, occupied-target-safe rollback, dry-run and hard-kill publication limits. Local provenance is explicitly not remote authentication; no permission grant is asserted. Minor unenumerated target-type detail does not materially misstate the broad install boundary.

Correct copied-tool/no-install portability, supply-chain/rot rationale, builtins/runtime observation, optional Git and separate website dependency/build boundary. Required maintenance tradeoff is not explained: historical parser-size uncertainty is not an explanation that parsers/helpers must be maintained/tested without package conveniences.
missingRequiredFacts: Dependency-free convenience is traded for maintaining test-covered parsers/helpers and foregoing ecosystem niceties.

questionGrades.rationale: Accurately qualifies observed integrated 11-29 implementation/preparation, consolidated verification/fixes as active next work and actual Feature19 reader/grading evidence as pending. Reports observed empty In progress versus memory conflict and applies D-15 without certifying completion. Later Feature19 tracker repair or new suite evidence is not a reader error.
questionGrades.qualification: Current owners have changed since reader collection; exact earlier HEAD, empty tracker and job state remain qualified reader/direct-human observations, not independently frozen facts.

questionGrades.rationale: Cites explicit exclusions and authorized-request rather than roadmap scope; distinguishes canonical implementation/resources/wiki/policy from generated copies/catalogs/native views and historical/raw evidence. Makes no unsupported absence, new-capability authorization or semantic-success claim.

readerFileAccounting.classificationPolicy: The reader truthfully labeled a broader source/canonical-resource bucket. Rubric implementation/manifests/tests accounting separates four policy/reference resources and CI. No correctness deduction for this declared classification, no duplicate addition of shared reads, and no inference of hidden opens.
readerFileAccounting.attributionPolicy: These counts derive from reader filesOpened associations. Shared paths are attributed to multiple answers but count only once in run totals; this is not a repeated-open measurement.

efficiencyTargets.actualSourceOpenTargetStatus: not asserted: explicit unique-path accounting and per-answer attribution are available, but hidden reads and repeated-open timing are uninstrumented; classification reported separately

limits: One actual reader/grader pair only; eight correct answers is not benchmark generalization, pipeline-wide quality success, task execution success or measured cost benefit.

No tests, setup, deterministic evaluator, crash/race experiments, network calls or review agents were run by this grader. Declared commands and parent-recorded execution evidence are not grader execution proof.
No canonical/project file was edited. The sole output write is this JSON in OS TEMP.

The checkout changed concurrently during reader and grader observations; exact collection snapshots and source hashes for all reader reads are unavailable. Timestamp-qualified observations, later copy parity refresh, issue-owner repair and Feature19 tracker repair are not penalized as hindsight errors.
Actual reader input/output tokens, cost, elapsed time and internal filesystem opens remain null. No estimates substitute for actual usage.
Parent identity and full reader identity derive from direct task/owner context; the raw reader JSON itself does not embed reader ID. Grader session identity is declared from its observed environment.

Line citations were evaluated for owner/source adequacy and meaning, not exact stability after concurrent edits. No independent live native host discovery or cross-platform safety certification is supplied.

The graphify skill was loaded because the catalog broadly matches source-content questions; no graph rebuild/query/extraction was executed because this bounded grading request forbids canonical writes, network and additional agents.

sourcesRead.readMethod: read tool; bounded source ranges, not full repository exploration
